e.body:
**Towards foundation models for insurance risk modelling**（arXiv `2609.14576v1`）**是一篇**总**结**「**基**础**模型**能**给**保**险**风**险**建**模**带**来**什么」**的**综**述**论文****——**逐字标题**为**「**Towards foundation models for insurance risk modelling**」**，**作者逐字 **`Christopher Blier-Wong`****。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**新面 **PubMed（**健康**保险**线）＋**收**掉**上轮**留**下**的**候选」**。
**可核实信息（均 2026-09-25 arXiv API 实测，本轮复核）**：
**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它**的**核**心**例**子**具**体**到**可**想**象**，**且**指**向**「**接**进**已**有**流程」**而**不**是**「**换**掉**模型」****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**摘要**逐字**写**「**For example, a language model could identify a worsening injury in a new claim note, allowing a reserving model to recognise the change in expected cost before the payments reveal the deterioration.**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**对 **RIAA** 最有用**：**⭐ 即**准**备金**（**reserving）**的**输入**在**传统**流程里**只**有**已**发生**的**赔付**流水**，**而**理**赔**笔**记**里**往往**已**经**写**着**伤**情**在**恶化**——**⭐ 若**能**把**这**一**条**信号**提**前**接**进**模**型**，**就**能**在**赔付**数据**滞后**的**窗口**里**先**动**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**这**是**「**非**结构**化**数据**接**入**已**有**精算**链条」**的**最**小**可**行**形态**，**比**「**用**大**模型**做**定价」**这**类**说**法**具体**得**多**（**⭐ 与**第 **382** 轮**记下的**「**先**画**激**励**结**构**再**画**编**排**图」**同**属**「**先**找**最小**可**行**接**入**点」**）。
**⭐⭐ ② 它**明**确**要**求**评**估**三**件**事**，**并**加**一**条**合规**约束****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**摘要**逐字**写**「**We propose a process to connect these model outputs to actuarial calculations and to assess their predictive contribution, stability and compliance with rules on information use.**」**；**⭐ 本词条**据此**指出**：**⭐ 即**「**有**没有**用」**（**predictive contribution）**、**「**稳**不**稳」**（**stability）**、**「**能**不**能**用」**（**compliance with rules on information use）**三**问**要**同**时**答**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**模型**报告**里**把**这**三**问**写**成**三**个**小**节**，**就**覆**盖**了**技**术**、**运**营**与**合规**三**类**读者**关**心**的**问**题**；**⭐ 而**「**rules on information use（**信息**使用**规则）**」**这**个**说**法**值**得**注**意**：**它**不**是**泛**指**隐私**法**，**而**是**指**「**哪**些**信息**在**什么**条件下**可**以**用**于**个**体**定价」**。
**⭐⭐ ③ 它**把**保**险 **ML** 的**三**条**结**构**性**评**估**困**难**逐字**写**出****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**摘要**逐字**写**「**Evaluating these applications is difficult when final claim costs become known only after long delays, large losses are rare or patterns learned elsewhere fail to transfer to the target portfolio.**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**：**⭐ 即**标**签**迟**到**（**long delays）**意**味**着**「**等**到**能**评**估**时**，**业**务**假**设**已**变」**；**大**损**失**稀**少**意**味**着**「**尾部**永**远**样本**不**足」**；**迁**移**失**败**意**味**着**「**在**别**人**数据**上**学**到**的**模**式**不**一**定**适**用**于**你**的**组**合」**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**这**三**条**可**以**当**成**保**险 **ML** 项目**的**风**险**清**单**（**⭐ 与**第 **380** 轮**记下的**「**评**估**困**难**在**于**最**终**成**本**很**晚**才**知**道」**同**源）**。
**⭐⭐ ④ 它**同**时**点**出**两**个**系**统**性**风**险**（**隐**私**与**可**保**性、**供**应**商**依赖）****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**摘要**逐字**写**「**Richer data can reveal private information and support finer risk classification, which can change access to insurance. Reusing the same models across insurers also creates dependence on shared predictions and providers.**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这**两**句**是**本**条**最**值得**引**用**的**：**⭐ 第**一**条**是**「**更**细**的**分类**可能**改**变**可**保**性**」**（**即**技术**能力**提升**的**同时**，**部**分**人**可**能**变**得**更**难**投**保）**；**第**二**条**是**「**全**行业**复用**同**几**个**模型**会**形**成**对**同**一**批**供应**商**的**共同**依赖」**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**这**是**「**模型**集中**度**风险」**的**清**晰**表**述**（**⭐ 与**本站**已**收**的 **[[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]** 与 **[[insurance-governance]]** 主**题**相**关）**。
**⭐⭐ ⑤ 元数据**形态**与**引**用**口径****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**记录**逐字**给出 **id **`http://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14576v1`**、**published 与 **updated 均 **2026-09-13**、**作**者 **`Christopher Blier-Wong`**、**`arxiv:comment`／**`arxiv:doi`／**`arxiv:journal_ref`** 三**个**字**段**均**为**空**、**摘要**实测 **1,643** 字符**；**⭐ 本词条**如实**指出**：**⭐ 即**它**是**一**篇**尚**未**见**期**刊**信**息**的**预**印**本**（**⭐ 与**本**轮**其**他**条**目**的**元**数据**形**态**一**致）**——**故**引用**时**要**写**明**版**本**与**时**点**。
**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[open-insurance-llm]] 覆盖**保险**领域**开源**模型**、**[[llmware-industry-bert-insurance]] 覆盖**行业**微调**模型**、**[[ai-in-actuarial-science]] 覆盖**精算**中**的 **AI** 全景**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**以**基**础**模型**接**入**精算**流程**、**并**同**时**讨**论**评**估**困**难**与**两**类**系**统**风险」这一**形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。
**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **从**最**小**可**行**接**入**点**开**始**（**笔**记 → **储**备**信**号）**；**② **评**估**要**同**时**答**「**有**用／**稳**定／**合**规」**；**③ **把**标**签**迟**到、**稀**疏**尾**部**与**迁**移**失**败**写**进**风**险**清**单**；**④ **讨**论**可**保**性**与**公平**，**而**不**只**谈**准**确**率**；**⑤ **留**意**全**行业**复用**同**一**模型**的**集中**度**风险**。
**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有阅读**其**正文**、**未**复**现**其**任**何**应**用**或**流程**，**故**不**主张**其**所**述**案**例**的**可**行**性**、**效**果**或**合**规**结论**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**arXiv** 记录**接口**返回的**元数据与摘要**（**摘要**实测 **1,643** 字符）**，**未读**其**全文**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**是**否**已**投**稿**或**发**表**（**记录**中 **`arxiv:doi`** 与 **`arxiv:journal_ref`** 均**为**空）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**所**评**述**的**各**类**模型**在**保险**场景**的**具体**表现**（**本词条**只**记**其**观**点）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**「**rules on information use」**所指**的**具**体**规则**体系**。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核实**其**是**否**附**带**代**码、**数据**或**示例**。**⑦ ⚠️ 窗口**状况**：**提交日 **2026-09-13** 落在**本轮**窗口**之内**（**基准日 **2026-09-27）**，**故**无需**缺口**说明**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-27 所见**；**⚠️ 涉及**基**础**模型**与**保险**定价**，**⚠️ 不**构成**任何**定价**、**核保**或**合规**意见**。

Foundation models learn patterns from large datasets before being adapted to particular tasks. 与 For example, a language model could identify a worsening injury in a new claim note, allowing a reserving model to recognise the change in expected cost before the payments reveal the deterioration. 与 In this paper, we review language, vision, geospatial, time series, tabular and scientific models, explaining existing insurance applications and potential future uses. 与 We propose a process to connect these model outputs to actuarial calculations and to assess their predictive contribution, stability and compliance with rules on information use. 与 Evaluating these applications is difficult when final claim costs become known only after long delays, large losses are rare or patterns learned elsewhere fail to transfer to the target portfolio. 与 Richer data can reveal private information and support finer risk classification, which can change access to insurance. e.body_en:
This is a review paper on what foundation models can bring to insurance risk modelling. **This entry belongs to the round theme of a new surface in a health insurance line together with collecting candidates deferred from the previous round.**
**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-25 from the preprint interface and rechecked this round**:
**First, its central example is concrete enough to picture and points at plugging into an existing process rather than replacing the model.** The abstract states that a language model could identify a worsening injury in a new claim note, allowing a reserving model to recognise the change in expected cost before the payments reveal the deterioration. **Reserving inputs traditionally come only from payments already made, while the claim note frequently already records that the injury is worsening, so bringing that signal forward lets the model move during the window where payment data lag, which is the smallest viable form of feeding unstructured data into an existing actuarial chain and is far more specific than saying a large model will do pricing.**
**Second, it requires three assessments plus one compliance constraint.** The abstract proposes a process to connect model outputs to actuarial calculations and to assess their predictive contribution, stability, and compliance with rules on information use. **Does it help, is it stable, and is it permissible must therefore all be answered, and writing these as three subsections covers technical, operational, and compliance readers at once. The phrase rules on information use is also worth noting, since it does not mean privacy law in general but which information may be used for individual pricing under which conditions.**
**Third, it writes out three structural evaluation difficulties for machine learning in insurance.** The abstract states that evaluation is difficult when final claim costs become known only after long delays, when large losses are rare, or when patterns learned elsewhere fail to transfer to the target portfolio. **Long label delays mean the business assumptions have changed by the time evaluation is possible, rare large losses mean the tail never has enough samples, and transfer failure means patterns learned elsewhere need not hold for a given portfolio, so these three form a ready-made risk checklist.**
**Fourth, it names two systemic risks at once, covering privacy and insurability as well as provider dependence.** The abstract states that richer data can reveal private information and support finer risk classification, which can change access to insurance, and that reusing the same models across insurers creates dependence on shared predictions and providers. **The first says finer classification can itself change who can obtain cover, and the second names model concentration risk clearly, namely that an entire industry reusing a few models develops a shared dependence on the same providers, both of which are the arguments most often cited in insurance AI governance and fairness work.**
**Fifth, metadata shape and citation convention.** The record gives an identifier, submission and update dates in the window, a single author, empty fields for the author comment, archival identifier, and journal reference, and an abstract of about sixteen hundred characters. **This is a preprint with no journal information visible, so citations should state the version and date of access.**
**Sixth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover open language models for insurance, an industry fine-tuned model, a panorama of AI in actuarial science, an insurance AI reliability benchmark, and insurance governance, **while this entry supplies the form of a review that connects foundation models to actuarial processes while discussing evaluation difficulties and two systemic risks. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**
**For RIAA**: **five practices transfer: start from the smallest viable integration point such as claim notes feeding a reserving signal; answer usefulness, stability, and compliance together; put long label delays, sparse tails, and transfer failure on the risk list; discuss insurability and fairness rather than accuracy alone; and watch for concentration risk when an industry reuses the same models.**
**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the paper text was not read and none of its applications or the proposed process was reproduced**, so no claim is made about feasibility, effect, or compliance conclusions. **Second, only metadata and abstract, measured at about sixteen hundred characters, were read**, not the full text. **Third, whether it has been submitted or published was not verified**, the archival identifier and journal reference fields being empty. **Fourth, the actual performance of the reviewed model families in insurance settings was not verified**, this entry recording only the paper standpoint. **Fifth, the specific rule system referred to by rules on information use was not verified. Sixth, whether code, data, or examples accompany it was not verified. Seventh, the submission date falls inside this round window against a baseline of the twenty-seventh of September. Eighth, this entry records what was visible on that date and states plainly that it constitutes no pricing, underwriting, or compliance opinion.**

**Towards foundation models for insurance risk modelling**（arXiv `2609.14576v1`）**是一篇**總**結**「**基礎模型能給保險風險建模帶來什麼」**的**綜述論文****——**逐字標題**為**「**Towards foundation models for insurance risk modelling**」**，**作者逐字 `Christopher Blier-Wong`**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**新面 PubMed（**健康保險線）＋**收掉上輪留下的候選」**。
**可核實資訊（均 2026-09-25 arXiv API 實測，本輪覆核）**：
**⭐⭐⭐ ① 核心例子具體到可想像，且指向接進已有流程**——**逐字**For example, a language model could identify a worsening injury in a new claim note, allowing a reserving model to recognise the change in expected cost before the payments reveal the deterioration.**；**⭐ 即**準備金的輸入在傳統流程只有已發生的賠付流水**，**而理賠筆記已寫著傷情惡化**——**⭐ 即**非結構化數據接入已有精算鏈條的最小可行形態**。
**⭐⭐ ② 明確要求評估三件事＋**一條合規約束**——**逐字**to assess their predictive contribution, stability and compliance with rules on information use**；**⭐ 即**有沒有用／**穩不穩／**能不能用三問同時答**。
**⭐⭐ ③ 三條結構性評估困難**——**逐字**final claim costs become known only after long delays, large losses are rare or patterns learned elsewhere fail to transfer to the target portfolio.**；**⭐ 即**標籤遲到、**尾部稀疏、**遷移失敗**。
**⭐⭐ ④ 兩個系統性風險**——**逐字**Richer data can reveal private information and support finer risk classification, which can change access to insurance.** 與 **Reusing the same models across insurers also creates dependence on shared predictions and providers.**；**⭐ 即**更細分類可能改變可保性**，**且全行業復用同一模型形成供應商共同依賴**（**模型集中度風險）**。
**⭐⭐ ⑤ 元資料形態與引用口徑**——**id `http://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14576v1`、**published／**updated 均 2026-09-13、**作者 `Christopher Blier-Wong`、**comment／**doi／**journal_ref 三字段均為空、**摘要實測 1,643 字符**；**⭐ 即**未見期刊資訊的預印本**，**引用要寫明版本與時點**。
**⭐⭐ ⑥ 與池內條目的關係**：[[open-insurance-llm]]、[[llmware-industry-bert-insurance]]、[[ai-in-actuarial-science]]、[[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]、[[insurance-governance]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**以基礎模型接入精算流程、**並同時討論評估困難與兩類系統風險**」**這一形態**。
**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **從最小可行接入點開始**；**② **三問並答**；**③ **把遲到、**稀疏與**遷移寫進風險清單**；**④ **談可保性與公平**；**⑤ **留意模型集中度風險**。
**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有閱讀其正文、**未復現任何應用或流程**，**不主張其所述案例的可行性、**效果或**合規結論**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀 arXiv 記錄介面返回的元資料與摘要（**實測 1,643 字符）**，**未讀全文**。**③ ⚠️ **未核實**其是否已投稿或發表**。**④ ⚠️ **未核實**其所評述各類模型在保險場景的具體表現**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核實**其 rules on information use 所指的具體規則體系**。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核實**其是否附帶代碼、**數據或**示例**。**⑦ ⚠️ 窗口狀況：**提交日 2026-09-13 在本輪窗口之內（**基準日 2026-09-27）**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-27 所見**；**⚠️ 不構成任何定價、**核保或**合規意見**。
